===The vampyre===
{{Checklist|
*Go back and speak to [[King Roald]].
*Take 25 '''unnoted''' [[pure essence|pure]] or [[rune essence]], a [[bucket]], a weapon and 1 free inventory slot.
**As a low level, you may need to make more than two trips if you will be taking food, although the Monk can be [[safespot]]ted over the pews using ranged or magic.
*Enter the temple again and proceed up the stairs, then the ladder until you reach the {{FloorNumber|uk=2}}. Talk to [[Drezel]]. {{Chat option|2 So, what now?|1 Yes, of course.}}
*Kill the level 30 [[Monk of Zamorak]] on the {{FloorNumber|uk=1}} to obtain a [[golden key]].
*Go back to the trapdoor where you killed the [[Temple Guardian]], climb down, and go through the first door.
*Study the monuments until you find one with a key.
*Use the golden key on the monument.
*Use the bucket on the well in the middle of the monuments.
*Go back to the top floor of the temple where [[Drezel]] is located.
*Use the [[Iron key]] on the cell door and open it.
*Talk to [[Drezel]].
*Use the [[blessed water|blessed bucket of water]] on the [[Coffin (Priest in Peril)|coffin]].
}}
